reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin bundle providing configurable utilities for environment and secret management, MCP servers, prompts, profiles, RSS aggregation, global search, codegraph inspection, and an interactive terminal; the terminal, profile, filesystem, and network capabilities warrant R2.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的综合插件包，提供环境变量与密钥、MCP 服务器、Prompt、Profile、RSS、全局搜索、Codegraph 和交互式终端等功能。
summaries.en: A plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that provides environment and secret management, MCP server configuration, prompts, profiles, RSS aggregation, global search, codegraph tools, and an interactive terminal.

capabilities: Manages environment variables and secrets in the host process environment
Configures local stdio and remote streamable HTTP MCP servers
Creates, copies, renames, and recursively deletes DSH profiles
Runs interactive shell commands through a PTY terminal panel
Fetches RSS or Atom feeds and writes daily Markdown digests
Indexes and queries project code graphs through local CLI operations
Searches historical sessions and plugin settings in the DSH web GUI
